title: Kuwii Jebiyey Axdiga La Qaxiyey
intro: Waagii hore ee bulsho curdin ah, qabiil ayaa mar ku noolaa guryo deyr leh, oo ku xiran heshiis. Markii heshiiskaas la khiyaameeyay, cawaaqib xumada ayaa ka soo ifbaxday bogagga Qur'aanka. Dadkani yaa ahaayeen, maxaase ku dhacay guryahooda iyo beerahooda?
clues: Waxaan ku noolayn qalcado na siiyay dareen ammaan oo been ah.
Waxaan ahayn dad Qorniinka ku dhaqma, haddana axdigii ayaan jebinay.
Kadib markuu noo yimid ayaan shirqool ku sameynay rasuulka, laakiin qorshahayagii wuu fashilmay.
Geedaha timirta ah waxaa lagu jaray amarkii Alle, taasoo ah calaamad muujinaysa awooddiisa.
Waxaa nalaga saaray guryaheenna, mana aanan soo laaban, si ciqaab ah caasinimadayada awgeed.
Quraanku wuxuu nagu xusay cutubka isu imaatinka, sheekadeennuna waxay u tahay digniin kuwa jebiya heshiisyada.

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: La masaafuriyay oo hantidoodii la qaatay
Waa la cafiyay oo way sii joogeen
outcome.answer: La masaafuriyay oo hantidoodii la qaatay

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
